announcements.headline: Half-year Report
announcements.insight: Shares remain suspended following June announcements. The delayed interim results release adds to uncertainty for investors awaiting clarity.

announcements.headline: Delay to publication of interim results
announcements.insight: Sorted Group Holdings faces a delay to interim results following its June suspension. Shareholders must monitor for further corporate updates regarding the ongoing trading halt.

announcements.headline: Suspension - Sorted Group Holdings plc
announcements.insight: Sorted Group Holdings plc shares are suspended following the corporate update announced in June 2026. Shareholders should await further developments regarding the trading halt.

announcements.headline: Corporate update & suspension of trading in shares
announcements.insight: Sorted Group Holdings has suspended trading in its shares. Shareholders should monitor further announcements for details regarding the suspension and potential corporate actions.
